question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The question **__was raised for discussion__** before the members during the assembly session.
solution:
The correct answer is "came up."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 
 
"Came up" means to move toward someone, in order to talk to them. (किसी से बात करने के लिए उसकी ओर बढ़ना)

 
 
• 
 
**Example**: *He **came up**__ to me and asked for a light.*

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The reason for selecting** "came up"** as the appropriate option is that it accurately conveys the idea that the question was introduced or brought forward for discussion.

 
 
• 
 
In English, the expression** "came up"** is commonly used in a discussion or meeting context when a topic or question is presented or raised for consideration.

 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Came off: **to be finished with or removed from something. (किसी चीज़ का ख़त्म होना या हटाया जाना)
 
• **Came round: **(used about an event that happens regularly) to happen. ((घटना का यथासमय) घटित होना)
 
• **Came out: **to appear; to be published. (प्रकट होना; प्रकाशित होना)
